blocks.text: The 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International delegates took a brief break from their tour of Cebu for a yoga session and to practice their “pasarela” (pageant walk) with experts. Before their turn on the runway in front of the judges, the 38 official delegates of this year’s competition strapped on their heels for a pasarela crash course with Antonio Gonzales in Lapu-Lapu City on Sept. 24. The pasarela coach and founder of MUSE Philippines counts international and national titleholders among his trainees, including reigning Miss Charm Philippines Apriel Smith, Miss Worldwide Philippines Nicole Borromeo and 2025 Miss Eco International Alexie Brooks.
